specs.label: Important
specs.value:
*1) Requires at least 200 lux illuminance. 2) Customizing the device requires the Logi Options+ App, available for recent versions of Windows and macOS at logi.com/optionsplus. 3) Logi Options+ App needs to be installed on all your computers and connected to the same network. 4) Signature Slim Solar+ Keyboard K980 off white recycled plastic content: minimum 52%. Excludes plastic in printed wiring assembly (PWA), and packaging. Signature Slim Solar+ Keyboard K980 graphite recycled plastic content: minimum 70%. Excludes plastic in printed wiring assembly (PWA), and packaging. 5) Wireless range may vary depending on the operating environment and computer setup
6) Logi Options+ App is currently not supported for ChromeOS, Linux, iPadOS, iOS and Android OS. The device’s basic functions will work without it. 7) With a fully charged battery, battery  life varies with use conditions. 8) Mouse not supported by iOS. 9) Actual key switch lifetime varies with use conditions. Projection is based on one million keystrokes per key switch in a year. 10) Lifetime projections are based on results from an 18 months testing conducted by the battery manufacturer. Actual Battery lifetime may vary based on user, environment and computing conditions. 11) Spare parts may not be available in some countries or regions. For more information, please visit www.logitech.com/support/slimsolarplus. 12) Light effects on strip not representative of product operation. 13) Out of the box, the AI launch key opens Microsoft Copilot in Windows or Gemini for ChromeOS if available on your device. Use of these or other AI tools may require a separate subscription/application and minimum operating system requirements. For more details, please visit www.logitech.com/support/slimsolarplus
